shortDescription: BlockBeats reported on September 22 that a trader identified as 0xc3ed was forcibly liquidated four times in just 14 hours as Bitcoin climbed. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the trader’s short position reached 375.8 Bitcoin and has now been fully wiped out.
